info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Authorizations API

params.name: personId
params.description: List authorizations for this user id.

params.name: personEmail
params.description: List authorizations for this user email.

items.docs: Lists all authorizations for a user. Either `personId` or `personEmail` must be provided. This API does not support pagination.

info.name: Delete authorization of org and client ID

params.name: orgId
params.description: The ID of the organization to which this person belongs.  If no orgId is specified, use orgId from the OAuth token.

items.docs: Deletes an authorization by org ID and client ID.

params.name: authorizationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the message.

items.docs:
Deletes an authorization by authorization ID.

Specify the authorization Id in the `authorizationId` parameter in the URI, which was listed in the list resource.

info.name: Get expiration status for a token

items.docs: Epoch-based expiration time for the token.
